info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Custody Administration Update API
info.description: The Custody Administration Update API facilitates the management of custody operations within the banking sector. This API enables authorized users to update essential details related to custody accounts, ensuring that records remain accurate and compliant with regulatory standards. Typical consumers include financial institutions and compliance teams that require efficient and secure updates to their custody information. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can maintain their operational integrity and enhance service delivery to clients.
